prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create a polished design exploration board for tactile clickable CULTURE TILES in a language-learning app, Bucket / Polingual. Exactly four large square collectible tiles arranged 2 by 2 on warm ivory background, photographed from slight overhead so their thick beveled edges and satisfying physical depth show, high quality product render, plenty of breathing room, each object same scale. Direction: cultured, playful, art-museum collectible, rich tactile material and deep handcrafted relief. Each tile has an expressive cultural artwork face, readable native country lettering, a small clean exact national FLAG BADGE occupying only the upper right corner, and a subtle tiny circular arrow button at bottom right indicating click/tap. Top left JAPAN: luminous oxblood urushi-like lacquer body, carved abstract flowing ripples, restrained raised gold line drawing of a lacquer bowl, large elegant Japanese type 日本 in gold; small Japanese flag badge white rectangular field with one red disc. Top right MOROCCO: jade and cream hand-cut ceramic mosaic joints with an original nonreligious angular arrangement, turquoise glaze pooling in grooves, an inset vessel outline, beautiful readable Arabic المغرب in dark jade centered in a quiet cream panel; small red Moroccan flag badge with centered green five-point outlined star. Bottom left INDIA: terracotta and indigo cotton block-print texture with original stamped dot and petal repetitions, raised wooden printing block pictogram, beautiful clear Devanagari भारत in dark indigo in a quiet cream panel; small accurate India flag badge orange-white-green horizontal with navy Ashoka wheel. Bottom right MEXICO: cobalt blue and warm white glazed Talavera-inspired tile rim, original floral brushstroke motifs, ceramic vessel relief, large elegant México lettering in cobalt on an ivory panel; small accurate Mexican flag badge vertical green-white-red with central emblem. All motifs original, no copied community-coded or sacred pattern. Four distinct cultural directions tied together by same chamfer, footprint, lighting and button geometry. Texture should be tangible and individual, not plastic, generic blobs, flags stretched across the whole face, or a flat web page. No outer page text or title. Do not copy any real maker's mark. Render at wide high resolution with all four tile objects entirely visible and readable.
